diagnosis: The source-gate job identifier contained a hyphen and was dereferenced with dot syntax.
Job-level environment expressions used runner.temp, where the runner context is unavailable.
local_reproduction: actionlint v1.7.12 reported the unavailable runner context; the corrected workflow passes actionlint with no findings.
resolution: Renamed the job identifier to source_gate, used github.workspace for task-scoped job paths, and validated the entire workflow with the official actionlint v1.7.12 binary whose release archive checksum passed.
